title: Initial condition recovery in nonlinear damped viscous photoacoustic tomography using a convolutional neural network-guided gradient-free optimization framework
summary: Photoacoustic tomography (PAT) is a hybrid imaging modality that combines high optical contrast with high ultrasonic resolution for biomedical imaging applications. In this work, we investigate the inverse problem of recovering the initial pressure distribution from boundary measurements in the presence of nonlinear acoustic propagation and viscous attenuation effects. To model these phenomena more accurately, we consider a nonlinear damped viscoelastic wave equation incorporating spatially varying sound speed, temporal attenuation, and nonlinear propagation mechanisms.
